gen-audiowide-gf-menbere: Futuristic and tile-like, Audiowide keeps every stroke the same width, tall lowercase standing against its capitals, while Menbere stacks its own tall letters like rolled cord. Menbere in sans-serif form reads smoothly.
gen-audiowide-gf-mitr: Audiowide draws its letters like bent cable, no swelling or thinning anywhere, each glyph set apart like a tile. And Mitr, a friendly sans, keeps capitals and lowercase nearly level.
gen-audiowide-gf-momo-trust-display: Momo Trust Display drifts along with generous, spaced-out letters and a big x-height, nothing fussy about it. And Audiowide's wire-bent curves never thin at the spine, which gives the pair its most striking quality.
gen-audiowide-gf-mukta: Crossbars as fat as the stems they join give Audiowide its blocky, tile-by-tile futurism, set against Mukta's tall-bodied little letters. Their strongest quality is the contrast in energy.
gen-audiowide-gf-mukta-mahee: Audiowide looks drawn with a marker tip, every stroke a constant width and every glyph set like a tile. But Mukta Mahee, chunky and tall in the lowercase, brings a friendly, approachable ground beneath it.
gen-audiowide-gf-mukta-malar: Audiowide is a plain stripe of constant ink, bent into futuristic shapes. It handles bold, techy display work, while Mukta Malar, with its compressed ascenders, handles the quieter job of being approachable text.
gen-audiowide-gf-mukta-vaani: Mukta Vaani carries a high-waisted lowercase that stays contemporary, while Audiowide above it never mixes bold-looking and light-looking strokes within a word. Text in it moves along smoothly.
gen-audiowide-gf-narnoor: Narnoor tucks short ascenders above big bowls, giving a professional texture, while Audiowide's t shares one width between crossbar and stem. Paragraphs in it move along steadily.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-display: Sharp, techy, and tile-like, Audiowide locks its stems and arcs in lockstep. Noto Sans Display answers with a big, tall middle zone in every word, so the two read as friendly and futuristic.
gen-audiowide-gf-play: Play holds a faint weight shift between upstrokes and downstrokes, with little height difference between cases, a mild approachable feel. Play against Audiowide's single-pen-tip look makes the pair's strongest quality its tech-meets-friendly spirit.
